inputs.<tmp:0>/progress.awawa:

	DESC "a step the run completed"
	FIELD DONE string
		REQUIRED
		DESC "what the step did, one line"

SCHEMA HANDOVER
	DESC "the state of a run that hands over"
	FIELD NEXT string
		REQUIRED
		DESC "the step to resume at"

STEP s1
	DONE "read the task"

STEP s2
	DONE "wrote the tests"
